fullName: package admission reader returns a record only for an instance that an act record names by path and digest
package admission reader refuses the whole read on unknown shapes instead of guessing
public-source policy act recognises the recorder's record by its exact path and format, in force from its instant
public-source policy act refuses the recorder's file when its act type, identity, title or provenance is not the recorder's form
egress version 2 record is read from the recorder's act: version 2 supersedes version 1 once in force
egress version 2 record leaves version 1 standing before the version 2 act takes effect, and with no version 1 act at all
egress version 2 record refuses when version 2 did not take effect strictly after version 1: the same instant, or earlier
egress version 2 record the RFC5-14 class amendment version 2 depends on is required: no record, an edited module, a wrong form, or an amendment later than version 2 all refuse
egress version 2 record withdrawal and forgery forms the reader does not define does not refuse the recorders' other act records or the aggregate acceptance record they append to
screening scope version 2 policy act counts the version 2 act when the policy carries the version 2 bytes, and the version 1 act goes quiet
screening scope version 2 policy act a version 2 act not yet in force leaves version 1 in force, in both views
screening scope version 2 policy act refuses an unlisted record that names the policy: another file, a subdirectory, a loose field spelling, a Unicode-hyphen identity
strict act reads policy chain: absent without acts; refused for a missing version 1, equal or earlier instants, equal arguments, a supersession that does not name version 1, or other policy bytes
round-3 review notes folds soft hyphens, zero-width spaces, underscores and spaces before matching a withdrawal stem (N-2)
round-3 review notes takes a time: a strict read of an act recorded after now is absent (N-4)
the policy port and the strict policy chain agree on every world in the fixture set, at every instant
